description: Meet the feathered residents of Tianhewan Yellow River National Wetland Park in Ningxia. Join us for a relaxing tour of this vibrant ecosystem. (recorded)
title: Tianhewan Yellow River national wetland park: A paradise for birds in Ningxia

author: New China TV
description:
Catch a glimpse of thrilling dragon boat races in China's Tongren, where paddles slice through the water and teams battle it out in a fierce test of speed, strength and teamwork.
Friday marks the Dragon Boat Festival, one of China's most celebrated traditional holidays, honoring the ancient patriotic poet Qu Yuan. The festival is marked by customs such as eating zongzi, wearing protective sachets and five-colored bracelets, and watching dragon boat races. (recorded)
title: Dragon boat racing heats up in Tongren, China

author: New China TV
description:
Sino-German economic and trade cooperation acts as the anchor of stability for bilateral ties and a powerful engine advancing China-EU industrial chain integration. 
Today we sit down with Michael Kern, newly appointed Executive Director & Board Member of the German Chamber of Commerce in China - East China, to unpack first-hand insights from Germany's business community based in China.
title: Spark Dialogue | New German Chamber chief on why China remains key to German business

author: New China TV
description: A childhood dream took flight across the Strait. When Teng Yu Fei from China's Taiwan region attended a Xiamen Airlines recruitment event in 2018, hearing the familiar Hokkien spoken during the interview instantly made her feel at home. Today, she is pursuing her dream in the skies while embracing new opportunities on the mainland.
title: Flight attendant from Taiwan embraces opportunities on the mainland

author: New China TV
description: The Dragon Boat Festival, or Duanwu, falls on the 5th day of the 5th lunar month (June 19 this year). Its signature tradition -- dragon boat racing -- dates back over 2,000 years. Today, the race reflects teamwork, courage, and perseverance, while also serving as a cultural tradition and global sport that brings communities together.
title: China's Duanwu Festival Tradition: Dragon Boat Racing
